verified_facts.text: The hotel is at the heart of the Peninsula of Lyon, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Lyon – Hotel Dieu is at the heart of the Peninsula of Lyon, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located in a landmark building originally dating back to the 18th century.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in a landmark building originally dating back to the 18th century

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers views of the Rhône river, the basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourviere, its historical courtyards and the city of Lyon.
verified_facts.excerpt: our hotel offers magical views on the Rhône river, the basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourviere, our historical courtyards, and the city of Lyon

verified_facts.text: The Soufflot Dome on the first floor towers 32 metres high.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 1st floor, the hotel’s breath-taking Soufflot Dome, towering 32 metres high

verified_facts.text: Le Dôme bar serves signature cocktails featuring local produce and local beers, from tea time to evening drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Signature cocktails featuring local produce, local beers all to savour with the international dishes imagined by chef Mathieu Charrois. From tea time to evening drinks.

verified_facts.text: Epona restaurant has an outdoor garden terrace, where chef Mathieu Charrois offers contemporary creations with local and seasonal flavours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sharing and generosity are the motto of this delightful restaurant with its exceptional outdoor garden terrace. In the kitchen, chef Mathieu Charrois offers you contemporary creations with local and seasonal flavours.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a Cinq Mondes Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in rejuvenation at The Cinq Mondes Spa

verified_facts.text: The Cinq Mondes spa has a sauna and steam bathing, with a masseuse available.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's concierge helps guests discover Lyon, from off-the-beaten-path activities to restaurants and shows.
verified_facts.excerpt: From off-the-beaten-path activities to great restaurants and shows, the city of Lyon is full of surprises. With an extensive knowledge of all the latest goings-on, our concierge will open up the greatest that our destination has to offer.
